title: Certified two-sided bracket on the logical error probability of the d=3 rotated surface code, one round, circuit-level depolarizing noise, under the lookup-table decoder

model.noise: circuit-level depolarizing, single parameter p on all four knobs (after_clifford_depolarization, after_reset_flip_probability, before_measure_flip_probability, before_round_data_depolarization)
model.semantics: Independent-mechanism fault model: each mechanism fires independently with its listed exact rational probability (the exact dyadic value of the IEEE-754 double emitted by Stim's detector_error_model). The certified statement is exact for THIS model; the independent-mechanism approximation of the depolarizing channels is Stim's standard DEM semantics.

mechanism_hash_spec: sha256 over newline-terminated lines 'det:obs:p_num/p_den' in canonical order (ascending by (det, obs)), UTF-8
decoder_spec: Lookup-table (coset-leader) decoder. BFS over syndrome space {0,1}^n_det from syndrome 0 (weight 0, predicted observable 0), FIFO queue, mechanisms applied in canonical index order; first assignment wins. Decoder output D(s) = pred[s]. F is correctable iff D(sigma(F)) == obs(F). Cf. Tomita & Svore, PRA 90, 062320 (2014) for lookup-table decoding of d=3 surface codes.

bracket.statement: L <= P_L <= U, exact rationals, where P_L is the probability that the decoder's predicted observable flip differs from the actual observable flip under the independent-mechanism model.
bracket.tail_formula: T = P(W >= 5) where W = sum of independent Bernoulli(p_i) over all mechanisms; computed exactly by Poisson-binomial dynamic programming in exact rational arithmetic.
bracket.lower_bound_formula: L = sum over uncorrectable F, 1<=|F|<=4, of prod_{i in F} p_i * prod_{j not in F} (1-p_j).
